description: This file contains PHP code for generating report grouping UI components in vtiger CRM, including functions for generating HTML select options for columns and grouping time, and logic for handling report data and display.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template class used for rendering report grouping UI components.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_GroupingHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for primary module columns in report grouping.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumns_GroupingHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for secondary module columns in report grouping.

methods.name: getGroupByTimeDiv
methods.description: Creates HTML for selecting time-based grouping options in reports.
